cuts.name.crossfade.description: The name of a cut style (crossfade): in the Every cut select, the Cut style choices, the timeline’s cut markers and Review mode.

cuts.name.dip.description: The name of a cut style (dip): in the Every cut select, the Cut style choices, the timeline’s cut markers and Review mode.

cuts.name.slide.description: The name of a cut style (slide): in the Every cut select, the Cut style choices, the timeline’s cut markers and Review mode.

cuts.name.punch.description: The name of a cut style (punch): in the Every cut select, the Cut style choices, the timeline’s cut markers and Review mode.

cuts.labelPercent.description: A cut style with its size ("Punch-in, 110 %"). {name} is the style’s name.

cuts.labelSeconds.description: A cut style with its length ("Crossfade, 0.15 s"). {name} is the style’s name.

joinOptions.black.description: Clip tab › Cuts: the black swatch of a dip’s colour.

joinOptions.white.description: Clip tab › Cuts: the white swatch of a dip’s colour.

joinOptions.brandColour.description: Clip tab › Cuts: a swatch of the brand kit’s colours for a dip. {n} is its number, {colour} its hex code (#ff3b30).

joinOptions.crossfadeLength.description: Clip tab › Cuts: slider of a smooth cut’s crossfade length.

joinOptions.punchSize.description: Clip tab › Cuts: slider of a smooth cut’s punch-in size.

freeze.refusal.cut.description: Why a freeze frame cannot be added at the playhead: a cut. The notice, and the tooltip of Freeze frame at playhead.

freeze.refusal.taken.description: Why a freeze frame cannot be added at the playhead: a freeze already there. The notice, and the tooltip of Freeze frame at playhead.

freeze.refusal.frozen.description: Why a freeze frame cannot be added at the playhead: a picture already frozen. The notice, and the tooltip of Freeze frame at playhead.

freeze.refusal.full.description: Why a freeze frame cannot be added at the playhead: the limit reached ({max} is how many a project can have). The notice, and the tooltip of Freeze frame at playhead.

freezeSection.seconds.description: Freeze frame: a length in seconds (2.0 s).

freezeSection.holdTitle.description: Clip tab › Freeze frame: tooltip of Freeze frame at playhead (its shortcut follows in brackets).

freezeSection.removeTitle.description: Clip tab › Freeze frame: tooltip of Delete freeze (its shortcut follows in brackets).

freezeSection.hint.adds.description: Freeze frame: what a freeze that pauses the sound does. {length} is its length (2.0 s), {now} the video’s length with it (1:02.5).

freezeSection.hint.cut.description: Freeze frame: the hint for a freeze on a frame that is cut out.

freezeSection.hint.next.description: Freeze frame: the hint for a freeze the next one leaves no time.

freezeSection.hint.afterEnd.description: Freeze frame: the hint for a freeze at the very end that keeps the sound.

freezeSection.hint.end.description: Freeze frame: the hint for a freeze the end of the video leaves no time.

freezeSection.hint.holds.description: Freeze frame: what a freeze that keeps the sound does. {length} is its length (2.0 s).

freezeSection.hint.heldToEnd.description: Freeze frame: a freeze that keeps the sound, cut short by the end of the video. {length} is how long it holds.

freezeSection.hint.heldToNext.description: Freeze frame: a freeze that keeps the sound, cut short by the next freeze. {length} is how long it holds.

freezeSection.sound.pause.description: Freeze frame: the Sound chip that pauses the recording during the freeze.

freezeSection.sound.pause.title.description: Freeze frame: tooltip of Pause the sound.

freezeSection.sound.continue.description: Freeze frame: the Sound chip that lets the recording play on under the held picture.

freezeSection.sound.continue.title.description: Freeze frame: tooltip of Keep the sound playing.

freezeSection.sound.continue.atEnd.description: Freeze frame: tooltip of Keep the sound playing when the freeze is at the very end (the chip is off).

freezeMarks.groupSelected.description: Timeline: added at the end of a freeze frame’s tooltip when it is one of several selected items. {n} is how many are selected. Starts with a space and a middle dot.

freezeMarks.groupSelectSeveral.description: Timeline: added at the end of a freeze frame’s tooltip when nothing else is selected. Starts with a space and a middle dot.

freezeMarks.removeHint.description: Timeline: added after "Drag the edge to change" in a freeze frame’s tooltip. {keys} is the delete shortcut’s keycaps, never translated. Starts with a comma.

freezeMarks.nothingToHoldNext.description: Timeline: tooltip of a freeze frame that keeps the sound but the next freeze leaves it no time. {keys} is the delete shortcut’s keycaps.

freezeMarks.nothingToHoldEnd.description: Timeline: tooltip of a freeze frame that keeps the sound but the end of the video leaves it no time. {keys} is the delete shortcut’s keycaps.

groupEdit.option.zoomFocus.cursor.description: Selection view: the zoom focus chip that follows the cursor.

groupEdit.option.zoomFocus.cursor.title.description: Selection view: tooltip of the zoom focus chip that follows the cursor.

groupEdit.option.zoomFocus.fixed.description: Selection view: the zoom focus chip that holds a fixed point.

groupEdit.option.zoomFocus.fixed.title.description: Selection view: tooltip of the zoom focus chip that holds a fixed point.

groupEdit.option.textStyle.pill.description: Selection view: the text style chip for a caption pill.

groupEdit.option.privacyKind.blur.description: Selection view: the privacy effect chip that blurs.

groupEdit.option.privacyKind.blur.title.description: Selection view: tooltip of the privacy effect chip that blurs.

groupEdit.option.privacyKind.pixelate.description: Selection view: the privacy effect chip that pixelates.

groupEdit.option.privacyKind.pixelate.ti.description: Selection view: tooltip of the privacy effect chip that pixelates.

groupEdit.option.spotlightShape.ellipse.description: Selection view: the spotlight shape chip (ellipse).

groupEdit.option.spotlightShape.rect.description: Selection view: the spotlight shape chip (rectangle).

groupEdit.useZoomStyle.description: Selection view › Zooms: the link that gives the selected zooms the project’s zoom style again (and its row’s label).

groupEdit.seconds.description: Selection view: a length in seconds, the value of a slider (0.70 s).

groupEdit.name.spotlight.description: The name of a spotlight, as copied looks and notices call it ("Copied the … look").

groupEdit.name.image.description: The name of an image, as copied looks and notices call it ("Copied the … look").

groupEdit.name.titleCard.description: The name of a title card, as copied looks and notices call it ("Copied the … look").

groupEdit.name.freeze.description: The name of a freeze frame, as copied looks and notices call it ("Copied the … look").

groupEdit.name.chapter.description: The name of a chapter, as copied looks and notices call it ("Copied the … look").

groupEdit.name.stickerFallback.description: The name of a sticker whose name is unknown, inside "{name} sticker", as copied looks and notices call it ("Copied the … look").

groupEdit.name.sticker.description: The name of a sticker, as copied looks and notices call it. {name} is the sticker’s own name (Heart).

groupEdit.look.percent.description: Inside a copied look’s description ("Box: #ff3b30, 60 %"): a percentage.

groupEdit.look.style.description: Inside a copied text look’s description ("Text: Title style, 7 %"). {style} is the text style’s name.

groupEdit.look.filled.description: Inside a copied shape look’s description ("Box: #ff3b30, filled"): the shape is filled.

groupEdit.look.px.description: Inside a copied shape look’s description ("Box: #ff3b30, 6 px"): its line width in pixels.

groupEdit.look.dark.description: Inside a copied spotlight look’s description ("Spotlight: ellipse, 60 % dark"): how dark the rest of the picture is.

groupEdit.look.soundOn.description: Inside a copied freeze frame look’s description ("Freeze frame: 2.0 s, sound plays on").

groupEdit.look.soundPaused.description: Inside a copied freeze frame look’s description ("Freeze frame: 2.0 s, sound paused").

groupEdit.look.comesIn.description: Inside a copied pop-up look’s description ("Keyword pop-up: 8 %, in pop"): how it comes in. {motion} is the motion’s name in lower case.

groupEdit.look.label.description: A copied look’s description, in Paste look’s tooltip. {name} is the item’s name (Box), {parts} its look, comma-separated.

groupEdit.class.zoom.one.description: What one item of the zoom look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 zoom").

groupEdit.class.zoom.other.description: What several items of the zoom look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for zooms").

groupEdit.class.text.one.description: What one item of the text look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 text item").

groupEdit.class.text.other.description: What several items of the text look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for text items").

groupEdit.class.mark.one.description: What one item of the mark look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 shape").

groupEdit.class.mark.other.description: What several items of the mark look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for shapes").

groupEdit.class.privacy.one.description: What one item of the privacy look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 blur or pixelate area").

groupEdit.class.privacy.other.description: What several items of the privacy look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for blur or pixelate areas").

groupEdit.class.spotlight.one.description: What one item of the spotlight look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 spotlight").

groupEdit.class.spotlight.other.description: What several items of the spotlight look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for spotlights").

groupEdit.class.image.one.description: What one item of the image look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 image").

groupEdit.class.image.other.description: What several items of the image look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for images").

groupEdit.class.title.one.description: What one item of the title look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 title card").

groupEdit.class.title.other.description: What several items of the title look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for title cards").

groupEdit.class.freeze.one.description: What one item of the freeze look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 freeze frame").

groupEdit.class.freeze.other.description: What several items of the freeze look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for freeze frames").

groupEdit.class.graphic.one.description: What one item of the graphic look class is called, inside notices ("Pasted the look onto 1 pop-up").

groupEdit.class.graphic.other.description: What several items of the graphic look class are called, inside notices and tooltips ("The copied look is for pop-ups").

selectionPanel.class.zoom.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected zooms, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.mark.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected shapes, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.privacy.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected privacy, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.spotlight.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected spotlights, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.image.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected images, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.title.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected title cards, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.freeze.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected freeze frames, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.class.graphic.description: Selection view: title of the section of the selected pop-ups, before their count in brackets.

selectionPanel.classCount.description: Selection view: a section’s title, its kind of item (Zooms) and how many are selected.

selectionPanel.zoomLevel.description: Selection view: a selected zoom’s name, with its level (2×).

selectionPanel.cursorSpotlight.description: Selection view: the name of a spotlight that follows the cursor.

selectionPanel.popUp.description: Selection view: the name of a pop-up that is missing.

selectionPanel.onlyKind.description: Selection view: a button that keeps only the items of one kind; kind picks the kind’s short name in the plural, {n} is how many are selected.

selectionPanel.freezesAtEnd.description: Selection view: notice when Keep the sound playing cannot apply to freeze frames at the very end. {n} is how many.

selectionPanel.shorter.description: Selection view: notice when a new length could not apply to every item. {n} is how many came out shorter.

selectionPanel.duplicateTitle.description: Selection view: tooltip of Duplicate (its shortcut follows in brackets).

selectionPanel.copyTitle.description: Selection view: tooltip of Copy (its shortcut follows in brackets).

selectionPanel.pasteLookTitle.description: Selection view: tooltip of Paste look (its shortcut follows in brackets).

selectionPanel.deleteTitle.description: Selection view: tooltip of Delete (its shortcut follows in brackets).

selectionPanel.selectedItemsCount.description: Selection view: the folding list of the selected items, with how many there are.

selectionPanel.secondsMinus.description: Selection view: button that moves the selection earlier by {n} second (with a real minus sign).

selectionPanel.secondsPlus.description: Selection view: button that moves the selection later by {n} second.

selectionPanel.secondsUnit.description: Selection view: the unit after the Length field (seconds).

selectionPanel.appliesTo.description: Selection view: a property’s label when only some of the section’s items take it ("Filled · applies to 1 of 3").

selectionPanel.ownMotionCount.description: Selection view › Zooms: after Use zoom style, how many of the selected zooms have a motion of their own.

selectionPanel.noCursor.description: Selection view › Zooms: tooltip of Follow cursor when the recording has no cursor data.

mixedControls.labelMixed.description: Selection view: accessible name of a chip row or colour row whose items differ. {label} is the row’s label.

clipPanel.gap.cut.description: Clip tab: title of a selected gap that is a cut part (a noun: the part that was cut out).
